dialogues.speaker: Sido
dialogues.text: Hmm? What are you two doing here? You must have a lot of free time on your hands to come all the way out here...

dialogues.speaker: Sido
dialogues.text: Seems like the competition is just a piece of cake for you two! You guys are spectacular!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Have we met before? Paimon must've forgotten...

response.speaker: Sido
response.text: I'm here on a mission. I'm sorry, but that's all I'm able to disclose.

response.speaker: Sido
response.text: Do your best in the competition. I have faith in you.
